errors.evidence: The description of the bar patterns is inaccurate. Both bars have a diagonal hatching pattern; the difference is the background color (white for '本文方法' and gray for '基线模型'). Describing the latter as simply '灰色填充' (gray fill) is incorrect as it omits the hatching pattern.

errors.evidence: The description swaps the values for '本文方法' between the '近' (near) and '中' (middle) categories. The chart shows the bar for '近' is higher (approx. 59.4%) than the bar for '中' (approx. 59.2%), but the description reports the opposite (59.2% and 59.4% respectively).
In the '近' (near) category, the bar for '基线模型' (baseline model) aligns exactly with the 59% gridline, not approximately 58.8%.

errors.text_span: 在“远”距离类别中，本文方法约为59.2%
errors.evidence: In the '远' (far) category, the bar for '本文方法' (this paper's method) is visibly below the 59% line, at approximately 58.9%. The stated value of 59.2% is incorrect and corresponds to the '中' (middle) category.
In the '远' (far) category, the bar for '基线模型' (baseline model) is visibly above the 56% line, at approximately 56.2%. The stated value of 56.0% is incorrect.
